description: Returns a company's dividend data: yield, per-share amounts, growth, whether cash flow covers the payout, and the payments observed in its daily price history; projections never exceed the measured coverage. Without a symbol, returns the highest-yielding payers among the tracked companies and possible initiators. A company outside the ranking (a foreign issuer, for instance) returns the payments observed in its price history. Use it when the user asks whether a company pays a dividend, how much, or which companies yield the most. Estimates, not advice.

symbol.description: Ticker. Omit for the sector ranking.
